units.tenor_coordinate: 15th of contract month; coordinate only, not expiry

data_provenance.data_vintage: retrospective official annual archives; point-in-time not verified
data_provenance.calendar: dates observed in SHFE workbooks; unfilled, not an inferred holiday list
data_provenance.transformations: declared merged contract labels expanded; cuYYMM selected and sorted; no roll, date filling or price repair
data_provenance.expiry_metadata: not supplied; contract-month midpoint is a coordinate only

importer_audit.scope: 2016--2025 copper only; reserved 2026 archive not opened by import audit

counting_policy.view: explicit opt-in single-sided equivalents from per-workbook notes only; no year fallback
counting_policy.known_double_sided: only where workbook notes explicitly declare double-sided counts
counting_policy.known_single_sided: only where workbook notes explicitly declare single-sided counts
counting_policy.unavailable: missing declarations remain unknown; no year inference

held_out_2026.source: provided acquisition metadata only; reserved archive not opened by audit

local_record_policy: contract-level prices, forecasts and P&Ls are not exported
